name: Soft Dome
summary: A pillowy mosque dome and a plump minaret with a rounded balcony turn sacred architecture into a warm, cheerful silhouette.
why: The dome swells into broad rounded shoulders and a soft prayer hall. A rounded minaret with a broad balcony replaces the familiar pointed tower, while one generous open entrance keeps the building legible. Lilac, violet, and peach make the identity gentle and welcoming.
risk: The playful treatment feels less formal than conventional mosque imagery. Its rounded minaret is an abstract architectural interpretation rather than a literal tower.
sub1: A soft and welcoming prayer hall
reasonToChoose: You want the app to feel friendly, calm, and unusually soft.
